# Film decoder v1.3.6 rebase inventory

Compared file contents of pristine v1.3.2, pristine v1.3.6, and our v1.3.2-based tree. Paths are relative to `third_party/film-decoder/`. Upstream overlap means the same file changed, not necessarily the same lines.

Local capabilities include full-rate and aim-only tracks, aim-derived shot direction and sub-frame offsets, movement sticks and stances, control-place shooter attribution, drawn weapons, damage, kill causes, gestures, ammo reads, the inputs codec, direct film-cache sources, and embedded catalog bytes. The rows include their wiring, tests, fixtures, and revision guards.
